# Bar bending schedule calculator and rebar cutting optimizer

> Free, open-source tool: reads a bar bending schedule (mark, bar size, BS 8666 shape code 00, 11, 21 or 51, or any 90-degree shape by geometry, dimensions, members, bars each), works out each cut length with the minimum scheduling radius for the size (2d to 16 mm, 3.5d from 20 mm) rounded up to 25 mm, weighs it per mark and per bar size, and plans the cutting from one or more stock lengths with the least steel bought (cutting-stock LP by column generation for a proven lower bound, then whole-bar plans; marked proven optimal when the plan meets the bound). Runs in the browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). A scheduling aid, not engineering or detailing advice; check every length against the drawings.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://marisstella.app/rebar-schedule/)
- [How to calculate a bar bending schedule, with a worked example](https://marisstella.app/rebar-schedule/how-to-calculate-bar-bending-schedule.html)

## Inputs

- Schedule as CSV, tab-separated (pasted spreadsheet cells) or semicolon-separated. Header names: mark, dia/size, shape, members, each, A, B, C, D, E, R (radius override). Without a header: mark, size, shape, members, each, A..E.
- Stock bar lengths in mm (default 12000; several allowed), rounding step (default 25 mm), loss per cut (default 0, shear), offcut length worth keeping, optional steel price per tonne.

## How it is checked

- Radius table and kg/m pinned to the published BS 8666 and BS 4449 values; chart formulas for shapes 11 and 21 checked against exact bend geometry at every size.
- Cutting plan optimal on 150 of 150 random small schedules against exhaustive search; LP optimum certified by duality.
- 200 generated schedules from 12 m stock: proven optimal in 197, at most one bar over in 3; first-fit decreasing bought more bars in 122, about 1% more steel. Generated schedules, not real jobs.

## Source

- [Source code, CLI and README](https://github.com/duncan-haywood/oss-monorepo/tree/main/ventures/rebar-schedule): FSL-1.1-MIT licensed. `node cli.mjs schedule.csv --stock 12000,6000`, or `--example`.
